description: We are seeking a dedicated Full-time Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) to join a dynamic team in Gainesville, FL. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to patient recovery and well-being in a supportive environment. You will play a crucial role in implementing individualized therapy plans and helping patients achieve their rehabilitation goals.This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate, providing a stable and rewarding career path. Join a team committed to delivering high-quality care and making a positive impact on the lives of residents.
requirements: Current Florida state licensure as a COTA
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation environment
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $28.00 - $37.00, based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Full-time Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Gainesville, FL. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to patient recovery and well-being in a supportive environment.

As a PTA, you will work under the supervision of a licensed Physical Therapist, implementing treatment plans and assisting patients in regaining mobility and function. This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate, allowing you to make a significant impact while advancing your career.
requirements: Current Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) license in the state of Florida
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate for PTA is $28.00 - $37.00, based on experience.

description:
Join a dedicated team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Gainesville, FL, as a Full-time Speech-Language Pathologist (SLP). This is an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact on the lives of residents, helping them regain and improve their communication and swallowing abilities.

As an SLP, you will be responsible for assessing, diagnosing, and treating speech, language, cognitive, and swallowing disorders. You will develop individualized treatment plans, collaborate with interdisciplinary teams, and provide comprehensive therapy services to enhance the quality of life for our patients.

We are seeking a passionate and skilled professional eager to contribute to a supportive and patient-centered environment. This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate and the chance to be part of a facility committed to exceptional patient care.
requirements: Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC) from ASHA
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40.00 - $52.00 based on experience.

description: Are you a dedicated Certified Dietary Manager looking for a rewarding opportunity in a vibrant community? A premier skilled nursing facility in St. Petersburg, FL, is seeking an experienced professional to lead its dietary services. This facility, with a comfortable census of 43 residents within its 55-59 bed capacity, offers a supportive environment for both residents and staff.Located on a main street with abundant shopping nearby and nestled in a nice neighborhood, this facility provides an excellent work-life balance, being just 15 minutes from the beautiful beaches of St. Petersburg. Enjoy working in a facility that features two courtyards, providing pleasant outdoor spaces. This full-time, 8-hour shift role offers a chance to make a significant impact on resident well-being through exceptional dietary care.
requirements: Proven experience in dietary management, preferably within a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Strong understanding of food service regulations and sanitation standards
Ability to manage a dietary team and ensure high-quality meal service
